nodes.label: Rationale: Atomic SQL for Payment Consistency

properties.explanation: Changed from read-then-write to atomic SQL UPDATE (amount_paid = amount_paid + ?) to prevent double-counting payments due to race conditions between concurrent reads and writes
properties.trade_off: Slightly more complex SQL but eliminates data corruption risk

nodes.norm_label: rationale: atomic sql for payment consistency

properties.explanation: Chose SQLite over cloud database because dental clinics may not have reliable internet; the app must work fully offline with no external dependencies
properties.trade_off: No multi-device sync or cloud backup, but guarantees availability

properties.explanation: Chose clean light theme inspired by Cursor.com for professional appearance; sidebar navigation with grouped menu items for intuitive workflow
properties.trade_off: Hardcoded Segoe UI font may not be available on all machines

nodes.label: Rationale: Repository Pattern for Data Access

properties.explanation: Separates data access from business logic for clean architecture; enables changing database implementation without modifying business rules
properties.trade_off: Additional abstraction layer adds code but improves maintainability

nodes.norm_label: rationale: repository pattern for data access

properties.explanation: PyInstaller bundles entire Python runtime into one ~95 MB executable so doctor can run without installing Python or dependencies
properties.trade_off: Large file size (~95 MB) but zero setup required for end user

properties.explanation: Authentication was not implemented in v1.0.0, likely for speed of initial development; security audit identifies this as the top risk requiring architectural changes for regulatory compliance
properties.trade_off: Faster development but critical security gap violating IT Rules 2011 and DPDPA 2023
